claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised free concerts every evening with the latest songs at 619 Market street, St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: ToM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist the world, 619 Market street. Free conce every evening. Latest songs of the day

claims.statement: Tom Allen styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world in a June 1891 advertisement.
claims.excerpt: ToM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist the world, 619 Market street. Free conce every evening. Latest songs of the day

notes: Advertisement only; the rest of the page concerns the Bardsley inquiry, which does not involve Allen.
